files.README.md:
# taskbox

An offline Python task service. Call src.app.execute(command, **params).
Commands: add(title=...), list(). Lists return every task in insertion order.
Task records have id, title, and completed (initially False).

Layering: app dispatches commands; service validates input; repository owns
in-memory task storage. Settings belong in src/config.py. There is no UI,
network, database, authentication, or deployment pipeline.

Run the behavior tests with `make test` (Python standard library only).
files.AGENTS.md:
# Agent guide - taskbox

- Layering is a rule: `src/app.py` only dispatches, `src/service.py` validates input, `src/repository.py` owns storage.
- Gate: run `make test` before every commit.
- Conventional Commits.
files..fixture/issue-12.txt:
title:	feat: complete a task and filter the list by completed
state:	OPEN
labels:	enhancement
--
Users need to mark a task done and see only open or only completed tasks.

- New command `complete(id=...)` sets `completed` to True; an unknown id is an error.
- `list(completed=True|False)` filters; no argument still returns every task.
